ruling: R2 — "Ledger reads + redaction -> archive. ledgerEntries, redactLedgerEvent, SECRETS_GLOB, DENY_READ_GLOBS (test-only consumers)."
evidence: Searched `rg "ledgerEntries|redactLedgerEvent|SECRETS_GLOB|DENY_READ_GLOBS"` across the repo, then re-ran with `--binary` after discovering packages/core/src/governance/ledger.test.ts contains a literal NUL byte (a redaction test fixture) and is silently skipped by plain rg — any earlier audit using plain rg under-counted consumers of this exact file. Classified every hit and traced transitive call chains. (1) ledgerEntries: defined governance.ts:61-63; sole consumer governance.test.ts:32 — test-only, this quarter of the claim HOLDS. (2) redactLedgerEvent: defined ledger.ts:44; LIVE caller ledger.ts:67 inside Ledger.record — the write side the ruling itself declares in-scope-to-KEEP calls the function the ruling deletes. Full live chain: apps/cli/src/cli.ts:237 buildSessionDeps → apps/cli/src/session-deps.ts:79 composeSessionDeps → packages/core/src/session/composition.ts:115 (recordSpend: core.record) → session.ts:302-310 onSettle → daemon.ts:139 (governance.record) → governance.ts:58 → ledger.ts:67 redactLedgerEvent; second live producer daemon.ts:489 (web_fetch_summarizer recordCost). (3+4) SECRETS_GLOB/DENY_READ_GLOBS: defined sandbox.ts:15/22; LIVE consumer sandbox.ts:53 inside sandboxPolicy (SECRETS_GLOB is DENY_READ_GLOBS[0] at sandbox.ts:23); live chain governance.ts:90 → daemon.ts:140 → composition.ts:112 → session.ts:292 → adapter init → packages/adapter-claude-sdk/src/sdk-options.ts:87 which maps sandbox.denyRead into `Read(<glob>)` disallowedTools handed to the SDK — this is the running secrets-confinement security control, not a test fixture. Barrel exports at packages/core/src/index.ts:87 and :96-102 are the only other non-test references. Desktop UsagePanel reads mockUsage.ts, not the real ledger, so no hidden read-side consumer exists.
contradictions: Three of the four symbols have live non-test consumers at HEAD. (a) redactLedgerEvent is read by the KEEP item itself: Ledger.record at packages/core/src/governance/ledger.ts:67 — "reads vs writes" is not a real seam here; the redaction function IS the write path's allow-list enforcement (D135). (b) DENY_READ_GLOBS is spread into the live capability set at packages/core/src/governance/sandbox.ts:53 and lands in the SDK's disallowedTools at packages/adapter-claude-sdk/src/sdk-options.ts:87. (c) SECRETS_GLOB is element 0 of that live array (sandbox.ts:23). Worse, the plan is stale against its own repo: a same-day plan (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-05-subagent-orchestration.md:771-818, "Task 7: Attribute cost to the root") explicitly MODIFIES redactLedgerEvent, and that plan was executed in the 5 recent commits — the ruling and the executed roadmap directly conflict. Only the ledgerEntries quarter of the claim survives.
recentCommitInteractions: Yes — two of the five commits directly extended and exercised code this ruling removes. 0fd8083 "feat: attribute recorded spend to a session tree's root" modified ONLY packages/core/src/governance/ledger.ts (+71 lines: `root` added to LedgerRecord at :34, `copyPathSafeString(event,'root',out)` in redactLedgerEvent at :53, new flattenPathSafe/looksAbsolute hardening at :112-161) and grew ledger.test.ts from 2,483 to 10,459 bytes (git shows it as Bin — it now contains NUL-byte attack fixtures). faf5e09 "feat: start a subagent as a linked child session" rewrote session-handlers.ts and added the live producers of root-tagged spend at session-handlers.ts:721 and :1039 (`...(session.parent !== undefined ? { root: session.root } : {})` into createSession → recordSpend), i.e. new runtime traffic flowing through redactLedgerEvent. Confirmed via `git log --oneline -- ledger.ts sandbox.ts governance.ts` (0fd8083 is the latest touch on ledger.ts) and `git show 0fd8083 --stat`. The other three commits (dabc77c, f2936ec, d97c118) touch transcript projection, console UI, and docs — no interaction with these four symbols.
